newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander mutual and pensions funds up 72%.
newsitem.headline: Santander mutual and pensions funds up 72%.

text.p: Spain's leading bank Santander said on Tuesday that in 1996 the value of its mutual and pension funds under management rose 71.7 percent worldwide to 4.21 trillion pesetas.
A statement, with the bank's 1996 results, added that mutual funds were 71.6 percent higher at 3.62 trillion pesetas and pension funds grew by 72.4 percent to 594.67 billion.
The note added that in Argentina, Santander became the market leader on acquiring local pension funds Activa-Anticipar.

Banco Santander said earlier on Tuesday 1996 net attributable profit rose to 85.60 billion pesetas from 75.39 billion pesetas. Net profit rose to 120.53 billion from 101.87 billion while pre-tax profit rose to 163.19 billion from 146.00 bilion pesetas.
